title: TB preventive treatment
dek: After disease is excluded: 3HP or 3HR preferred; 1HP or 4R as alternatives; 6H/9H still valid; 6Lfx for MDR/RR contacts. TPT is not mini-HRZE.
story: WHO 2024 TPT module: once TB disease is ruled out, treat infection in people with HIV, household contacts, and other risk groups. Strongly recommended rifamycin–INH short courses: 3 months weekly rifapentine+INH (3HP) or 3 months daily RIF+INH (3HR). Alternatives: 1 month daily rifapentine+INH (1HP) or 4 months daily rifampin (4R). 6 or 9 months daily INH remain acceptable. Contacts of MDR/RR-TB: 6 months daily levofloxacin (6Lfx).

Ruling out disease uses symptoms, CXR (±CAD), and mWRDs as available. In people with HIV in high-transmission settings, TPT should not be held hostage to a missing IGRA. Infection testing is desirable when it changes who you treat.

CDC’s US overlay still talks 3HP, 4R, 3HR, 6H/9H with slightly different ranking language. Doses: 3HP is weekly RPT 900 mg + INH 900 mg × 12 in adults; 1HP is daily RPT 600 mg + INH 300 mg × 28. Do not confuse with Study 31’s daily RPT 1200 mg.
deep: Rifapentine/rifampin induce ART, anticoagulants, and calcineurin inhibitors. 6H exists partly as the interaction escape hatch.
6Lfx for MDR contacts is not “a bit of FQ for luck.” Confirm the source’s FQ susceptibility if you can; do not use 6Lfx if the index is FQ-R.
Pregnancy: 6H or 3HR are the usual WHO-comfortable options; rifapentine TPT safety data are more limited — follow the current module, not a tweet.
Completion, not prescription, is the endpoint. Digital adherence and self-administered 3HP are programme tools, not a different drug.

visual.caption: TPT menu after disease exclusion. Short rifamycin courses first; INH monotherapy still valid; 6Lfx is an MDR-contact regimen, not DS-TPT.

example.title: Contact of FQ-R RR-TB
example.setup: Child contact of a parent on BPaL because gyrA D94G. Disease excluded in the child.

steps.title: 3HP is the wrong antigen of prevention
steps.body: The source’s strain is not killed by INH/RIF if it is MDR/RR. 3HP assumes DS infection.

steps.title: 6Lfx assumes FQ-S
steps.body: This source is FQ-R. Levofloxacin TPT is misbuilt. Expert/NTP individualised prevention, not autopilot 6Lfx.

steps.title: Close follow-up
steps.body: When you cannot give a clean TPT regimen, surveillance intensity goes up. That is also prevention.

example.takeaway: TPT drugs must match the source’s DST, not the default poster.

choices: Daily rifapentine 1200 mg with moxifloxacin for DS-TB disease
Weekly rifapentine plus isoniazid for 3 months as TPT after disease exclusion
check.answer: Weekly rifapentine plus isoniazid for 3 months as TPT after disease exclusion
check.why: Do not collide with HPMZ daily RPT.

check.prompt: WHO 2024: a household contact of FQ-S MDR-TB, disease excluded, TPT of choice is:
check.why: 6Lfx is the MDR-contact regimen. 3HP is DS-TPT.

check.prompt: On the TPT hierarchy, why does the MDR/RR row say “not 3HP”?
choices: Because 3HP is built for DS infection; it does not cover a rifampin-resistant source strain
